title: CuriosityIntentV1
description: K0→K1 SSE event payload: a P06 Active-Learning curiosity question pushed to the K1 concierge so it can decide whether to surface it to the user. Carries the originating gap_id (so the answer can be back-correlated to the gap that prompted it), a natural-language question, and the remaining curiosity budget for the active session (the concierge throttles when budget is low).

envelope_id.description: Per-event ULID. Used as the SSE Last-Event-ID cursor token (D13).

gap_id.description: Knowledge gap identifier; correlates the answer back to the originating P03 gap.

question_text.description: Natural-language question to surface to the user.

budget_remaining.description: Remaining curiosity budget for the active session.

tenant_id.description: Tenant identifier; defaults to space owner if absent.

space_id.description: Memory-space identifier the gap was detected in.
